label: Bekanntmachungsservice (oeffentlichevergabe.de)
terms_note: German federal notice service; open data; daily ZIP per pubDay.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (daily eForms XML export). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence high.
reference.limits: - Open data; bids on buyer platforms. - German federal notice service; open data; daily ZIP per pubDay.

reason: Remaining gap: ZIP archive decoding with record extraction and client-side filtering. The only open API (Bekanntmachungsservice OpenData API 1.0.0, https://oeffentlichevergabe.de/documentation/api/opendata) is GET /api/notice-exports?pubDay=|pubMonth=&format=eforms.zip|ocds.zip|csv.zip — re-checked 2026-09-25 it answers a ZIP archive ('content-disposition: attachment; filename=notices_2026-09-01_OCDS.zip', bytes 'PK\x03\x04') of every notice published that day or month; there is no search or per-notice call. The runtime (including the 2026-09-25 CSV/JSON-part additions) parses JSON, XML and text/csv bodies only and cannot unpack a ZIP or filter the OCDS/eForms records inside it.
